rev.t: Bought a box of Ratnagiri Alphonso mangoes here. But when I checked them for artificial ripening, the mangoes appear to be floating (indicating artificial ripening!!). Even after paying premium prices, there’s no quality guarantee. :(

First of all I am a regular customer at this place from the past 5-6 months and I use to love shopping fruits and other stuff over here. Lately my experience has been worst literally, I mean like literally. Since I am a regular customer I …
It is a small store compared to the Jaya nagar branch but nonetheless has a good collection of groceries, breads. Soft drinks, juices, fruits, cereals, noodles, yogurt etc.
